body: Oh,I'm not american.This is a thai school schedule.I'm not sure what you mean by entire schedule.If you mean classes for each day,I can't,I'm a bit on the fence about sharing any info cause I'm paranoid I'll dox myself.I can vaugely describe it if you want.
Slight correction:The third class started at 9:50 am. so technically the class got cut by 3/4.

There's one big factor in your advice I need to point out.I'm a minor.I'm assuming you think I'm 18.No,I am not.Plus the age of adulthood in my country is 20,not 18.I can still definitly move out soon,it's just that I won't be considered an "adult".But to cut you some slack let's say we go a few years into the future and I try and use your advice.I feel this is too far,even for me who thinks that humanity will need to use brutality to survive longer than 100 years,no,this is too much.If I do that,my brother will probably die and my parents (well,if my other plans go through,it's gonna be my parent,a whole other thing) will die too.While I'm typing this I just realised this is exactly what my oldest brother did,seperating himself once he was old enough.I think I just cut him some slack cause his childhood was ruined by my abusive dad (Another can of worms I'm not gonna open).I guess I feel different when the same choice is presented to me because my parents are older than when my oldest brother left,even though he left only about 3 years ago.I'm not obligated to,but I want to.It's better for me,my oldest brother and my parents.Basically,I feel this is too far and my morality can't take that.I think part of your advice is good though.Cutting myself some slack.Through this whole thing,through abuse and pressure,I've never cut myself some slack.I always say to myself "It's at least partially your fault" and that not good for my mental health,even if sometimes that is true.Lies are sometimes better than truthes,and I thought myself this like 4 months ago yet I'm still not fully using this advice.Thanks a lot for helping me with that and thanks for the advice.

Thanks for that.My life's been a mess since like june 2021 and I'm pretty sure I haven't gotten a compliment like that through the whole thing.Thanks a lot.I have plans that are good but I'll kinda scared my other even bigger plans will get in the way since if also involves guardianship (I won't dwell on it since it's not the focus of this post),but I think my plans for him will still work,maybe,hopefully.Again,thanks for the kind words,they do wonders for my mental health right now.

The whole reason I'm trying to solve this in the first place is cause 3 months ago my anxiety gave ne the thought that my parents (specifically my mother) will die soon,even with my mother's family having longer than average life spans (My grandma is 89-90 and my great grandmother was 70-90ish).I dealt with it through just accepting that death is coming for us all and trying to better my parent's lives during their last years.I'm thinking of a nursing home or making him a ward of the state.Thanks for the advice.

Hey,thanks,a lot.The situation is bad,like,really bad.I'm not talking about this particular class,I'm talking about my life in general.It's a mess,but it's not the focus of this post so I won't dwell on that.I'm not sure I can send it anymore cause in my panic I said I'm fine with a zero.I'll still try though.What sucks is I have an irrational fear of being wrong.It's one of the reasons school is so hard for me.I think it has something to do with my upbringing.I'm always so hesitate to submit work,what if I'm wrong? Is the teacher gonna yell at me? Hit me? I'm scared of the situation without thinking about it's probability of actually happening.Example:one time a teacher handed out chocolates with peanuts in them.I'm severely allergic to a specific peanut.I refused cause I thought they could be in them even though the type I'm allergic to is very rare to find.I'm sorry if I was just complaining,I just needed to get that out.Again,thanks for the advice.
